# svg2pdf.js 2.0.0

Pinned compatibility build for the initial Sticky Fingers parity phase.

Source URL: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/svg2pdf.js@2.0.0/dist/svg2pdf.umd.js`.

The common framework uses the separately pinned 2.2.3 build. Sticky Fingers remains on 2.0.0 until its export parity tests permit an upgrade.
